params.name: page
params.description: The page number from which to start (0-based)

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return

params.name: search_fields
params.description: String names of fields to search. Correspond by index to search field values

params.name: search_field_values
params.description: Values of fields to search. Correspond by index to search fields. Unless field name contains "list", an individual search field value cannot be a list

params.name: order_by
params.description: The field whose value should be used to order the results

params.name: order_by_direction
params.description: The direction in which to order the results

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to include in the response

params.name: start_datetime
params.description: The start datetime for filtering results

params.name: end_datetime
params.description: The end datetime for filtering results
